#   git branch -f feat/atlas-ips-fix origin/feat/atlas
#   git push -u origin feat/atlas-ips-fix
#
# ── Start and watch ──
#   C-c m r   in this buffer      start the program (validates first)
#   C-c m p                        the program buffer (status per node)
#   RET on a node                  its run workspace (status, trace, time)
#   C-c m d  decisions            C-c m l  runs list
# Stack-mode branches (PR bases are shown per node in the program buffer):
#   feat/atlas-ips-fix--12p0  (cut from feat/atlas-ips-fix)   <- the stack-merge PR
#   feat/atlas-ips-fix--12a   (cut from --12p0)
#   feat/atlas-ips-fix--12b   (cut from --12a)
#   feat/atlas-ips-fix--12c   (cut from --12b)
#   feat/atlas-ips-fix--12d   (cut from --12c)
# TT_BRANCH itself is never moved; the conductor publishes locally. Push the
# five branches and open the PRs yourself (each stacked, base = the previous
# one). 12p0 does the LOCAL merge only: its push, CI, reviews, the owner E2E
# gate and the final merge into feat/atlas stay with you.

# Before starting:

#   - no vendor keys are needed: plan 12 uses recorded fixtures;
